task_completion.description: Extract the human HBB sequence (P68871) from the multispecies FASTA file and save it to wt_hbb.fasta.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file named wt_hbb.fasta is created or open in UGENE/text editor showing the sequence starting with MVHLTPEEKS.

task_completion.description: Create the Sickle Cell variant by mutating Glutamate (E) at position 7 to Valine (V) and saving to sickle_hbb.fasta.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file named sickle_hbb.fasta is created or open showing the sequence starting with MVHLTPVEKS (the 7th character is 'V' instead of 'E').

task_completion.description: Determine the Molecular Weight (MW) and Isoelectric Point (pI) for both sequences using software tools.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing a 'Statistics' or 'Protein Analysis' window in UGENE or a web tool with MW and pI values for both sequences.

task_completion.description: Document the MW and pI values for both variants in charge_analysis_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing charge_analysis_report.txt containing MW (~16.0 kDa) and pI values (WT ~6.74, Sickle ~7.13).

task_completion.description: Identify which variant has a higher pI and which migrates faster toward the anode at pH 8.6.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The report text explicitly states that the Sickle variant has a higher pI and the Wild-Type (WT) variant migrates faster toward the anode.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI or a web-based bioinformatics tool rather than just writing the file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, sequence editor, or protein analysis dialogs being actively used.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information into a file without performing the analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the 'Statistics' or 'Report' features in UGENE to derive the pI and MW values.

integrity.description: The agent correctly identified the 7th residue for mutation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence editor shows the cursor or highlight at the 7th position (E to V) of the HBB sequence.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Wild-Type (WT) sequence starts with MVHLTPEEKS (pI ~6.74, MW ~15,998 Da). The Sickle variant (E7V) starts with MVHLTPVEKS (pI ~7.13, MW ~15,968 Da). Because the WT has a lower pI, it is more negatively charged at pH 8.6 and will migrate faster toward the positive anode than the Sickle variant. The Sickle variant has the higher pI.
